name: YearlyReview_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners reviewing the previous year's finances together
setting.background: They want to improve their budget based on actual spending patterns

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing the previous year's spending
scenario_template.note: They compare expected spending with what actually happened. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Finding several categories that consistently exceeded their estimates
scenario_template.note: They discover that irregular expenses were easy to overlook. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Using past spending to create next year's budget
scenario_template.note: They want the new plan to reflect reality rather than ideal behavior. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Choosing new spending limits and savings targets
scenario_template.note: They compare lifestyle priorities with long-term goals. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Adding sinking funds for predictable annual expenses
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
